title: what matters most
subtitle: values are directions, not finish lines

steps.text: underneath wants are values: what matters most about how to live.
values aren't goals to finish. they're more like directions. there's always a step to take that way.

steps.prompt: tap the ones that feel most like you. up to five.
steps.reply: these are yours. no ranking needed.

steps.text: when did you last do something that fit one of them?

options.label: today
options.reply: lovely. that's what living by your values looks like, mostly small things.

options.label: this week
options.reply: nice. it's usually small things, and they count.

options.label: a while ago
options.reply: that's okay. noticing it is already a step back toward it.

steps.prompt: one small thing this week that fits what matters:
ideas: say what i actually think once.

steps.text: values are directions, not finish lines. any small step that way counts.

source.label: acceptance and commitment therapy (Hayes et al., 2006)

steps.text: do the small thing you wrote, even for five minutes.

grounding.idea: values work is a core process of acceptance and commitment therapy
grounding.source: Hayes et al., 2006, Behaviour Research and Therapy
